ShopBot Index › Beyond UCP › ACP

Which stores publish an Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) discovery file?

In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 1 of 1,270 stores we could check publishes an Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) discovery file (0.1%). The store that publishes it is alphonsomango.in. The file is the Agentic Commerce Protocol discovery document at /.well-known/acp.json. OpenAI has written that merchants share catalogs through the Agentic Commerce Protocol for product discovery in ChatGPT (OpenAI, March 2026). Publishing the file is a declaration, not proof that OpenAI checkout works at the store. Left out of the share: 1,584 stores we couldn't check. 1,139 of them were refused, and a refusal is not "no". A published file or profile is a declaration, not proof that agents can buy. ShopBot Index does not test purchases.

No big retailer met this check in this crawl.

How we check

We request /.well-known/acp.json after reading /robots.txt. It counts as published only on HTTP 200 when the JSON is an object whose protocol.name is acp (ACP). A store is one we could check when at least one website returned that file or a not-found response. Refusals, errors and checks we did not reach are left out. A store counts when at least one of its websites meets the rule. This page counts stores. The Beyond UCP table counts websites, so the two numbers can differ. How we check.
